messages:
maria: Kicking off prod deploy for routing changes. Feature flag routing_v2 will be ramped: canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 40m observation windows. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Routing will be via deploy-bot — pinging @sre-oncall for watch.

deploy-bot: Started rollout release=v2026.03.18-routing, stage=canary, target=prod-edge-*, status=in_progress

ryan: Quick ask — can we pin fallback model to v1.8 before we increase traffic? last time an unpinned fallback caused OOM thundering.

maria: Good call. Pinning fallback: model_default -> v1.8. Also set surge_guard.threshold=60 rps for the pool.

ci-cd-bot: Applied toggle: routing_v2 -> set_percent=1; regions=[NA,EU]; autoscaling.cooldown=5m
```bash
# example command applied by ops
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/flags/routing_v2 --data '{"percent":1,"regions":["NA","EU"]}'
```

vesna: I'll watch latency and 5xx closely for the first 15m. Abort criteria: p50 > 1200ms OR 5xx% > 0.5% at any checkpoint.

deploy-bot: Canary progress update: progressed to 5% at 1801234600 — metrics p50=780ms, 5xx=0.12%

emily: :thumbsup: infra looks healthy from my side.

vesna: Heads-up — at ~25m we saw CPU spike on prod-edge-3, tail latency +200ms. Held ramp at 5% and opened alert.

sre-oncall: I'm flipping surge_guard.mode=restrict and adding +2 nodes to the serving pool now.

deploy-bot: Ramp paused at 5%. Actions applied: surge_guard=restrict, pool.scale=+2. Observability: https://console.redwood/internal/observability/rollouts/1801234567

maria: Metrics returned to baseline after scaling. Resume ramp to 25%.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% completed at 1801234900 — metrics p50=810ms, 5xx=0.14%

vesna: Okay to proceed to 100% over next hour unless we see regressions. Adding release notes: "routing_v2 — deterministic route selection, improved retry semantics, experimental quantization; fallback pinned to v1.8."

ryan: Adding quick rollback play: to disable immediately: `/ff disable routing_v2 --by=oncall --reason="rollback"` — logs will auto-pin traffic to model_default=v1.8.

deploy-bot: Note: If rollback invoked deploy-bot will set routing_v2=0% and restore previous release v2026.03.17. Fallback pinned to v1.8 ensures correctness during rollback.

maria: Thanks team — we'll keep watch for the next hour. Will file a short release note and post to #product after 100% complete."
